leadText:
(Japanese: 激勝！ポケモンカードゲーム！！ Exciting Victory! Pokémon Card Game!!) is a Pokémon manga. It was published in Dengeki Nintendo DS (デンゲキニンテンドーDS) 2010, 2011 and 2012. It was illustrated by Tamori wa Taru (タモリはタル) under the name Tanaka Udon (たなかうどん).

 

 
 
 
 

it:Gekishou! Pokémon Card Game!!
zh:激胜！宝可梦卡牌游戏!!
